sourceNote: イーブイヒーローズ: MEASURED by pokemon-infomation.com across ~1,000 aggregated boxes (30,000 packs). Their per-BOX figures: SR(ポケモン) ~30.0%, SR(サポート) ~15.0%, SA(特別なアートのSR) ~30.0%, HR(ポケモン) ~10.0%, HR(サポート) ~10.0%, SA(特別なアートのHR) ~5.0%, UR ~10.0%; RR 4-5枚 and RRR 2-3枚; one card from the combined SR/SA/HR/UR pool guaranteed per box (~10% of boxes carry two). The site is explicit that the guarantee is one card from that whole pool, NOT an SR specifically. This era's catalog has no AR or SAR tier, so bands map as the sibling パラダイムトリガー and ロストアビス files do: ultra_rare = SR + SA(SR) = 30+15+30 = 75%/box; hyper_rare = HR + SA(HR) + UR = 10+10+5+10 = 35%/box; double_rare = the RR (4-5) plus RRR (2-3) band = 7.0/box, the only set here where the source breaks RRR out separately. Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the sample is large and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by this box's 30 packs. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: per-box guarantees are FOLDED INTO the slot rates rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive.
